parameters.query: SELECT id, fingerprint, source, target_market, name, company_name, contact_phone, contact_whatsapp, contact_telegram, contact_instagram, website_url, location_wilaya, category_niche, raw_content, detected_language, identified_pain_points, proposed_service FROM leads WHERE status = 'new' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 10;

=UPDATE leads 
SET ai_fit_score = {{ $json.ai_fit_score }},
    ai_scoring_reasoning = '{{ $json.ai_scoring_reasoning.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    proposed_service = '{{ $json.proposed_service }}',
    ai_pitch_draft = '{{ $json.ai_pitch_draft.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    status = '{{ $json.status }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}';
